items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: So I went to -- a trumpet player, I was asking, who can I go to around here to give me some lessons to improve my reading... Well, they sent me to a guy named Hi Lama.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, yes, yes. So I went to -- a trumpet player, I was asking, who can I go to around here to give me some lessons to improve my reading, you know. And I just wanted to learn how to sit down like the rest of the guys and come right in, pull my horn out, tune up and look over and play it.
Well, they sent me to a guy named Hi Lama.
How do you spell that? H-y?
